title: Rust core engine (WASM)
description: Core game engine in Rust: JSON parser, game definition loader, state representation, legal move generator, state transition engine. Compiles to WASM via wasm-bindgen. This is the MIT-licensed embeddable engine that runs identically on client and server.
notes: Must emit structured JSONL event log (see baize-562.6) during game execution. Same events as Python implementation for mechanical diffing.
